explanations.headline: Triple cut
explanations.text: Everything outside the two jokers switches sides: the 36 cards above the first joker and the 3 cards below the second trade places. The 15 cards from one joker to the other stay exactly as they were.

explanations.headline: Count cut
explanations.text: The bottom card is 2H, worth 28. Move 28 cards from the top to just above it. The bottom card itself never moves. That is the same as moving the 25 cards above the bottom card to the top.

explanations.headline: Read the output card
explanations.text: The top card is 7D, worth 20. Counting 20 down lands on 5S. That card's value is this round's keystream number. The deck is not changed by this step.
